stem:
The random variables $X$ and $W$ have probability density functions $\text{f}$ and $\text{g}$ defined as follows:

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} p(a^2 - x^2) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

$$\text{g}(w) = \begin{cases} q(a^2 - w^2) & -a \leqslant w \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$, $p$ and $q$ are constants.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Write down an expression for $q$ in terms of $p$ only.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Given that $\text{E}(X) = 3$, find the value of $a$.
